intro_native: This looks like an IKEA TILLREDA microwave, with two dials and a round button on the right. Let's learn how to heat up some food.
intro_en: This looks like an IKEA TILLREDA microwave, with two dials and a round button on the right. Let's learn how to heat up some food.

buttons.function_native: Sets how strong the heating is, from Min up to Max. The snowflake is for defrosting.
buttons.function_en: Sets how strong the heating is, from Min up to Max. The snowflake is for defrosting.

buttons.function_native: Sets the cooking time, up to 30 minutes. Turning it past 0 starts the microwave.
buttons.function_en: Sets the cooking time, up to 30 minutes. Turning it past 0 starts the microwave.

buttons.function_native: Press it to open the door.
buttons.function_en: Press it to open the door.

steps.narration_native: Find the round button at the bottom of the white panel on the right. Press it, and the door will pop open.
steps.narration_en: Find the round button at the bottom of the white panel on the right. Press it, and the door will pop open.

steps.action_native: Put the food in and close the door
steps.action_en: Put the food in and close the door
steps.narration_native: Put your food in a microwave-safe dish, with no metal. Set it in the middle of the glass plate, then close the door firmly.
steps.narration_en: Put your food in a microwave-safe dish, with no metal. Set it in the middle of the glass plate, then close the door firmly.

steps.action_native: Turn the power dial to Max
steps.action_en: Turn the power dial to Max
steps.narration_native: Now look at the top dial. Turn it all the way to the right, to the word Max. That's the best setting for reheating.
steps.narration_en: Now look at the top dial. Turn it all the way to the right, to the word Max. That's the best setting for reheating.

steps.action_native: Turn the timer dial to the time you need
steps.action_en: Turn the timer dial to the time you need
steps.narration_native: Next, turn the middle dial with the clock symbol. Each number is minutes. For a plate of food, try about 2 or 3. The microwave starts on its own, there's no start button.
steps.narration_en: Next, turn the middle dial with the clock symbol. Each number is minutes. For a plate of food, try about 2 or 3. The microwave starts on its own, there's no start button.

steps.narration_native: Let it run. When the time is up, you'll hear a ding and it stops by itself.
steps.narration_en: Let it run. When the time is up, you'll hear a ding and it stops by itself.

steps.action_native: Open the door and take out the food
steps.action_en: Open the door and take out the food
steps.narration_native: Press the round button again to open the door. Carefully take out your dish. It may be hot, so use a cloth or oven mitt.
steps.narration_en: Press the round button again to open the door. Carefully take out your dish. It may be hot, so use a cloth or oven mitt.

steps.narration_native: Finally, make sure the middle dial points to 0. That way the microwave is fully off.
steps.narration_en: Finally, make sure the middle dial points to 0. That way the microwave is fully off.

tips.native: To defrost, turn the top dial to the snowflake, then set the time.
tips.en: To defrost, turn the top dial to the snowflake, then set the time.

tips.native: To soften ice cream, use Min. To soften butter, use the snowflake setting.
tips.en: To soften ice cream, use Min. To soften butter, use the snowflake setting.

tips.native: To stop early, just turn the timer dial back to 0.
tips.en: To stop early, just turn the timer dial back to 0.

tips.native: For less than a minute, turn the timer just past 1 and watch the food.
tips.en: For less than a minute, turn the timer just past 1 and watch the food.

tips.native: Not sure a dish is safe? Heat it with a cup of cold water on Max for 1 minute. If the dish gets warm, don't use it.
tips.en: Not sure a dish is safe? Heat it with a cup of cold water on Max for 1 minute. If the dish gets warm, don't use it.

tips.native: Stir food halfway and let it stand a moment before eating, so the heat spreads evenly.
tips.en: Stir food halfway and let it stand a moment before eating, so the heat spreads evenly.

warnings.native: Never put metal, foil, or dishes with metal trim inside.
warnings.en: Never put metal, foil, or dishes with metal trim inside.

warnings.native: Don't heat eggs in their shells or food in sealed containers. They can burst.
warnings.en: Don't heat eggs in their shells or food in sealed containers. They can burst.

warnings.native: Hot drinks can boil over suddenly. Stir them and wait a moment before taking them out.
warnings.en: Hot drinks can boil over suddenly. Stir them and wait a moment before taking them out.

warnings.native: If the microwave sparks, the door is damaged, or it keeps running with the door open, unplug it and contact IKEA support or your landlord. Never open the casing.
warnings.en: If the microwave sparks, the door is damaged, or it keeps running with the door open, unplug it and contact IKEA support or your landlord. Never open the casing.

closing_native: Great job! Just remember: power on top, time in the middle, and the round button opens the door. Enjoy your meal!
closing_en: Great job! Just remember: power on top, time in the middle, and the round button opens the door. Enjoy your meal!
